name: Excel
tagline: Build, style and fill Excel workbooks cell by cell; fill a styled template from data; read cells and sheets back.
description: Write and read Excel workbooks programmatically, cell by cell, with styling — an invoice, a statement, a report with several sheets, a filled template the finance team designed in Excel — over exceljs. Every function takes the workbook handle New Workbook or Open Workbook answers and gives it back; Workbook To Base64 and a Save File step turn it into a download.
author: Etyma
